title: Urgent Notice: Clearance of Outstanding Dues and Admission Suspension Warning
text:
📢 Important Notice for Students

Students are hereby required to clear all outstanding dues at the earliest to avoid further penalties or administrative actions.

Furthermore, students who fail to deposit their semester fee along with the already imposed fine will have their admission suspended from Monday, April 20, 2026.

For any fee-related concerns or assistance, kindly contact the Students Cell at the Treasurer Office.

Official Notification | Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
